[[File:Inside Team Rocket Mecha.png|250px|thumb|The Team Rocket trio inside a typical mecha]] '''Team Rocket's mechas''' refers to the many robots and machines [[Jessie]], [[James]], and {{MTR}} have used in their wild schemes throughout {{aniseries|PTS}} and its {{pkmn|manga}} adaptations. It is unknown how they get them–since they usually have little money–or how they are transported. The mechas first appeared in the second episode of {{aniseries|OS}}, ''[[EP002|Pokémon Emergency!]]'', with the debut of the Meowth Balloon. One-time mechas began to appear starting in ''[[EP034|The Kangaskhan Kid]]''. Typically, the mechas fail to accomplish their functions and are destroyed, some even before getting a chance to be used.
